text: ひやけが　いたく　なって　きちゃった…

structure.jp: いたく　なって　きちゃった…

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: なって　きちゃった
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus くる says a change has begun and is coming on. いたく　なって　きちゃった = 'it has started to hurt'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: なって　きちゃった
patterns.explanation: てしまう says the thing ended up happening, to your regret. ちゃった is its casual short form. なって　きちゃった = 'it's gone and started to get that way'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with く in place of い, plus なる, says something becomes that way. いたく　なって = 'becoming painful'.
